summary: Backend: all 12 pytest tests PASS (config shape, admin verify ok/401, file serving + 404, upload auth guards + config update, invalid slot 400, progress GET/POST + defaults, seed status). Frontend: full mobile flow PASS - app loads with temple background + Gopal idol, 9 progress dots, 10 tray items (snan/chandan/dress/crown/garland/flower/bhog/aarti/bell/sleep), language toggle bn/hi/en works, sound & music toggles work, dress sheet swaps to idol_blue, bhog sheet places laddu, all 9-step sequence marks progress green and triggers the bilingual completion card ('আজকের গোপাল সেবা সম্পূর্ণ হয়েছে / Today's Gopal Seva is complete.') with restart. Admin: wrong PIN shows error, PIN 1234 unlocks, all 15 image slots + 5 sound slots render with upload/replace buttons, Generate Default Images button visible. No React Native red screen, no critical console errors. Deprecation warnings noted (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated - use 'boxShadow' (SHADOW.soft/card in theme). Non-blocking on web but will emit warnings in newer RN versions.
react-native-web deprecation warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated - use 'textShadow' (styles.title). Non-blocking.
react-native-web deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated - use style.pointerEvents on <View pointerEvents='...'> usages (e.g. stageWrap, nightDim, hangBell). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Migrate shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents to their new API forms to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.

Re-seed or re-upload the 'flower' image slot: the upload test replaced the original AI-generated flower.png with a 1x1 transparent PNG. All other 14 seeded assets are untouched. To restore, hit Admin -> Generate Default Images (or POST /api/gopal/seed) or upload a proper flower image.
(Nice-to-have) Backend has no /api root-level health beyond '/'; add /api/health for standard probes.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: MongoDB _id is popped before returning config (server.py:82).
Good: All URLs use env vars (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, ADMIN_PIN).
Good: All interactive elements have testID (buttons, inputs, tray items, progress dots, sheet options).
Good: Async DB ops via motor + run_in_threadpool for blocking storage requests.
Minor: PositionsBody uses dict (no schema validation on nested values) - acceptable for admin-only endpoint but could be tightened.
updated_files: MongoDB gopal_config.assets.flower was overwritten by an upload test (see action_items)
seed_data_creation: Created 1 progress doc with test date prefix 'TEST-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS' (safe - not real date). Uploaded a 1x1 PNG to gopal-seva/uploads/image/flower/<uuid>.png and updated flower slot in Mongo config (side-effect of upload auth test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core APIs and flows are green. If retesting, be aware the 'flower' asset was replaced with a placeholder during upload testing - either restore before visual QA or ignore the flower thumbnail. localStorage-based seva state is per browser context; a fresh session starts with empty progress, so a full 9-tap sequence must be done in one session to trigger the completion modal.
